Read project settings

Source: R/yml.R
projr_yml_get.Rd

With profile = NULL, local settings in _projr-local.yml override the active profile settings, which override the defaults in _projr.yml. Supply a profile name to read its own configuration.

Usage

projr_yml_get(profile = NULL, check = FALSE)

Arguments

profile

A profile name, or NULL for the merged active settings. Use "default" to read the base configuration, "local" to read local overrides, or a named profile to read _projr-<profile>.yml.

check

Whether to validate the settings and report an error if they are invalid. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named list of project settings.

See also

projr_yml_check()
